description: Perform a Google search with optional domain filters. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

exclude_domains.description: Exclude these hostnames from search results, for example example.com. Type: Array. Optional; no client default.

items.description: One hostname to exclude from the search results, for example example.com. Type: String. Required.

include_domains.description: Restrict search results to these hostnames, for example example.com; omit for no inclusion filter. Type: Array. Optional; no client default.

items.description: One allowed hostname for search inclusion, for example example.com. Type: String. Required.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return; larger result sets may consume more credits. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 50. Default: 10.

query.description: Google search query to run; provide the words or phrase to search for. Type: String. Required.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

name: agentseo_search
title: AgentSEO Search
